body.p: (task 0.7). Maps follow : entry order kept, entries addressable by position (sxml_map_get_entry), hash index built on first lookup, persistent put/remove sharing structure. Keys compare by fn:atomic-equal with a consistent sxml_atomic_item_hash (equal numeric values of different types hash alike). Map construction takes a whole entry list and a duplicate-key policy (reject with XQDY0137, use first, use last); combining duplicates with a function is left to map:build/map:merge. Records are maps whose cell holds only field values plus the record type, whose field names and name index live once in the type registry ('s shared shapes); map:put on a record gives a plain map. Arrays are persistent vectors of sequences with O(log n) updates. A JNode is a cell (parent, key, value, child index, JTree identifier); roots take a fresh tree identifier so JTrees order among XTrees; children are made on demand and are identical when parent and key are (XDM 4.0, section 8.5).
